# Documentation Excellence v4.5 UX1

Document Workspace is now a first-class, read-only workspace beside Review
Workspace. Consultants can inspect the current document without repeatedly
exporting and opening Word.

The initial renderer shows document title, metadata, section headings, workflow
steps, instructions, screenshots and annotations. Review changes automatically
invalidate the document representation, and switching to Document Workspace
renders the latest validated Document Plan.

Both Word and Document Workspace use the same Review projection, Semantic
Document, Theme and Planner pipeline. Word export output and behaviour are
unchanged.

UX1 is intentionally foundational. Zoom, fit width, thumbnails, page
navigation, scrolling optimization and interactive document editing are not
included and remain candidates for later UX milestones.
